task.title: L8a.3: host protocol, three execution modes, offload sizing and fallback/refusal reasons
task.objective: Phase L L8a.3 (awkit-djnl.11). AiSettings gains executionMode (cpu default, gpu-offload, gpu-only) and a bounded VRAM reserve; old settings files load unchanged. The utility host's backend is fixed at fork: CPU as today, or Vulkan from the imported pack through the L8a.0 resolve hook, the pack re-verified by AiBackendPackStore.verifyForLoad immediately before every Vulkan host start. A new gpuPlan request measures devices, VRAM and the runtime's own GGUF estimators (no hand-written estimator) and reports the largest layer count that fits beside the reserve; load takes a bounded gpuLayers (a GPU host always offloads at least one layer; CPU stays gpu:false). AiService applies E4: GPU-Offload loads the largest safe count with a bounded smaller retry, then CPU with a visible reason; GPU-Only loads every layer or refuses with the exact shortfall and never falls back silently; a mode change reloads at the next load. E2: NVIDIA is PCI vendor 0x10DE from Electron's GPU info, never a name; mixed or unknown adapters are VENDOR_UNPROVEN, and the runtime's Vulkan device count must be explained by the NVIDIA adapters alone. The effective profile and every reason are reported in status and diagnostics. No Settings UI (L8a.4), no VRAM-exhaustion-after-load handling or GPU cancel measurements (L8a.5), no adapter picker (E2 correlation open), no CUDA.

security: No new permission: the mode and reserve are AiSettings fields written only by ai:updateSettings (AI_MANAGE with re-authentication).
A Vulkan host is forked only after AiBackendPackStore.verifyForLoad passes, and loads GPU binaries only from the directory that verdict names.
Eligibility is PCI vendor 0x10DE only; no product-name branching anywhere.
offline: No download, driver installation, source build or global runtime: build 'never', skipDownload, the imported pack only.
Nothing GPU enters the installer; the host script changes, so the signed dependency manifest is regenerated by a fresh package.

acceptance.description: The host keeps CPU exactly as before, loads Vulkan only from the pack directory it was forked with, reports its backend, plans offload from the runtime's own estimators and enforces gpuLayers bounds, with mutations of the new guards caught.

Fake-host deterministic cases: no GPU, unsupported GPU, mixed and multiple adapters, missing and tampered components, no usable device, low and sufficient VRAM, bounded retry, GPU-Only refusal with the shortfall, mode change reload, crash and cancel on the GPU host, CPU default untouched.

The real host and manager in Electron: CPU unchanged, the Vulkan host started only from a verified pack and refused otherwise, its loader bound to the app-managed folder, a real plan and a real offloaded inference on this machine's adapter (mechanics only, not NVIDIA qualification), and the product's E2 answer for this machine's adapters.
Typecheck, bundles, script typecheck and verifier registry pass.
